arStrings.szText: Saws grind up enemies around the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c}, periodically dealing {c_number}{payload:SAW_IMPACT}{/c} damage with a {c_number}[{SF_8}|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}{dot:EVISCERATE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} no longer Taunts but now lasts for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds and you redirect all damage to it so long as you stay in the area. It can absorb up to {c_number}[{SF_12}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life before it is killed. When the demon dies it explodes, dealing up to {c_number}{payload:BLAST_IMPACT}{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Fortifying{/u}{/c} you for up to {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c} based on the damage it absorbed.

{c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Occult{/c} Skill and now directly dominates a target's mind for up to {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} seconds, forcing it to Taunt your enemies and take {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DMG}{/c} damage when hit by them. Recast to command the target around the battlefield.
Casting {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds.

When enemies attack the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} they are enraged for {c_number}[{SF_23}]{/c} seconds, gaining {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Attack Speed but taking {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_3_DMG}{/c} damage when they hit targets.
Enemies and Demons killed Close to the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} extend its duration by {c_number}[{SF_27}|1|]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} seconds.
